name: Purrfect Squares
tagline: Draw a rectangle for every cat.
description: A cozy, untimed logic puzzle. Each numbered cat needs a rectangle of exactly that many squares, and every square of the wooden board must be covered. Drag from one tile to another to draw a rectangle, tap one to lift it, and lean on undo and hints instead of a clock. Two hundred Journey boards across eight chapters, all generated and checked for a single solution, plus daily, zen, expert and unlimited modes.
highlights: 200 Journey boards, each verified to have exactly one solution
Drag-to-draw rectangles with two-tap and keyboard alternatives
No timer, no lives, no move limit — unlimited undo and three-stage hints
Daily catnap, Zen, Expert and Unlimited modes, plus five unlockable themes
howToPlay: Drag across tiles to draw a rectangle, or tap one corner and then the other.
A rectangle must hold exactly one cat and have the same area as its number.
Tap a placed rectangle to lift it, and keep going until every tile is covered.
levels: 200 Journey boards · 8 chapters + daily, zen, expert and unlimited
